csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide Project Development Service for Small Town Reconstruction Project, Pavement Replacement, on SR-28 through the town of Tipton.SR 19, Pavement Replacement, From 1.05 mi S of SR 28 (SCL Tipton) to 0.55 mi N of SR 28(CR 100 S), in Tipton Co. 015+090 to 018+0-2INDOT is looking to continue the delivery of quality projects for our Small-Town Reconstruction Program. During the first phase of project development services for DES 1900253, the selected firm shall be responsible for preparation of Stage One Plans, Estimate and other tasks deemed necessary including but not limited to Survey, Red Flag, etc. as determined by Scope of Services meeting. Once the Scope of Work and Construction Estimates are determined, INDOT will assess ability to fund. If INDOT makes the determination to fund and proceed with the project, this contract may be amended to include the design of the project to completion and the additional services that may be included: Further Plan Development, Environmental Document preparation, Permit work, Right of Way Plan Development, Title Research, Utility Coordination, Construction Phase Services and others as needed. INDOT will provide Geotechnical Services and Real Estate Services as needed. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of Notice of Selection. The selected Consultant's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the Scoping meeting.
